meta.title: Custom websites
meta.description: Brisk designs and builds custom websites from Belgium. No themes, just a structure that wins customers and code that stays fast and accessible.

hero.title: A website that works while you work.
hero.lead: No theme, no page builder. We design and build your site from scratch, with a structure that wins customers and technology that lasts for years.
hero.shotAlt: {name}, a website designed and built by Brisk

whatYouGet.title: Everything a website needs. Nothing that slows it down.
whatYouGet.intro: Every site we build goes through the same five layers. Not a set of loose parts, but one whole that holds up from strategy to maintenance.

1.title: Strategy & structure
1.body: We start with what your customers are looking for and what you want to achieve. From there we shape a sitemap and page structure that makes sense to visitors and search engines alike.

2.title: Custom design
2.body: No themes, no templates. Every screen is designed around your brand, your offer and the way people actually use your site.

3.title: Development
3.body: We build with Next.js and a headless CMS: fast, accessible and ready to grow. Every page is tested on every screen before it goes live.

4.title: SEO & performance
4.body: Speed and search visibility are built in, not bolted on with a plug-in afterwards. Clean code, a sound structure and images that load before you notice.
4.tags: Core Web Vitals · Structured data · Analytics

5.title: Maintenance & growth
5.body: After launch we stay close. Updates, new pages and improvements based on what the numbers tell us.

speed.title: The bar we hold every project to.
speed.lead: A beautiful site that loads slowly is an expensive brochure. So every project gets the same treatment: fast, usable by everyone and easy to find.
speed.checksTitle: What we check before every launch

checks.1: Core Web Vitals: load time, interaction, stability
checks.6: Images in modern formats, sized to fit

1.title: Core Web Vitals
1.body: Load time, interaction and visual stability are measured during the build, not after it. Every page is tested before it reaches production.

2.title: Accessible to everyone
2.body: Semantic structure, contrast and keyboard navigation come standard in every design. Good for visitors, good for Google.

3.title: A CMS that grows with you
3.body: Headless and decoupled from the design. Adding a language, a page or an integration later never means a rebuild.

references.title: Sites that are live today.
references.intro: No mockups, just real sites for real clients. A selection of the work that is online today, from a design hotel to a made-to-measure workshop.

process.title: From first call to launch.
process.intro: Four steps and a clear proposal after the first call. You always know where things stand.

1.title: Intro call
1.body: A 30-minute conversation about your goals, your customers and what isn't working today. You then receive a clear proposal with scope and timeline.

2.title: Design
2.body: Structure and copy first, then the visual design. You review a clickable prototype before a single line of code is written.

3.title: Build
3.body: We build the site on Next.js with a headless CMS, test it on every screen and fill in the content together.

4.title: Launch
4.body: Domain, hosting and analytics are ready to go. After launch we keep an eye on the numbers and stay on hand.

faq.title: Good to know.
faq.aside: Can't find your question? Email us and you'll hear back within 24 hours.

1.q: What does a custom website cost?
1.a: It depends on the scope: the number of pages, the features and whether we also take care of copy and imagery. After the intro call you receive a proposal that spells out exactly what we build and when.

2.a: That depends on the scope. A compact site is ready sooner than a larger site with multiple languages or integrations. The proposal includes a timeline we keep track of together.

3.q: Can I edit the content myself?
3.a: Yes. Every site comes with a CMS where you manage copy, images and pages yourself. We walk you through it at handover, and you can always come back to us afterwards.

4.a: We handle hosting, domain and security updates if you want us to. You decide whether we keep building after launch: on a maintenance plan or per project.

5.a: You do. Design, code and content become your property at handover. You're not tied to anything and can always continue with another team.
